checks.browser: Chromium: every MP3 decoded and duration checked; word/example repeat playback, pause/resume and mobile layout checked.

independent_transcription.batching: Actual final MP3 clips joined with 350 ms silence. No expected-text prompt. Token timing and phonetic comparison are fallible, especially for isolated syllables.

contextual_alignment.method: Independent greedy transcription plus Chinese character CTC alignment using expected text; aligned text is not an independent transcription.

checks.waveform: Ordinary word and sentence cuts checked against measured source quiet intervals; 40 ms outside / 20 ms inside continuity RMS > 0.025 is a screening flag, not a count of proven pronunciation errors.
checks.contextual_refinements: 32/265/772/1543: inspected phonetic spectrograms and independent CTC anchors; revised coarticulated extraction and applied 3 ms fades at cuts.
